_note: Move families (v2.1, Zack 2026-10-26): moves and abilities that are different expressions of one job, read together across a team. "If you have a move like Sunny Day and Sandstorm and Hail and Rain Dance are all the same move in a sense of it's just different expressions of the same move ... all of those play into each other. I want that factored in." Each family names its forms; a form is set by moves or abilities. Facts are the Gen IV games' unless a field says otherwise. explain_pack.py ships this file to the app (explain.json, 'families'); the team page and the builder read it (app/web/82_labs.html, Families).

weather.label: Weather
weather.explain: Sun, rain, sand and hail are one job in four forms: each one changes the field for every Pokémon in the battle for five turns (eight with its rock). Only one weather is up at a time and the last one set wins, so a team with several setters can overwrite a rival's weather and choose its own.

abilities.Flower Gift: Attack and Special Defense ×1.5 for it and its partner

together.chip: Sand and hail both chip every Pokémon that isn't immune for 1/16 of its HP a turn, so a team with both keeps that pressure up whichever is set, and the members immune to both take none of it.

screens.label: Screens
screens.explain: Reflect and Light Screen are one job for the two kinds of attack: five turns (eight with Light Clay) of physical or special damage halved for the whole side. A team with both covers either kind of attacker.

hazards.label: Entry hazards
hazards.explain: Stealth Rock, Spikes and Toxic Spikes are one job: the other side pays each time a Pokémon comes in. They stack with each other, so each one a team lays makes switching costlier.

status.label: Status
status.job: Cripple a target for the rest of the battle
status.explain: Paralysis, burns, poison and sleep are one job in four forms: each takes a Pokémon out of its best plan for good, and a Pokémon can carry only one, so they don't stack on one target. Several forms let a team pick the one that cripples each threat most.
